## What lands

- **`/about/legal-demands/`** — a T1 zero-JS page under About carrying the written demand-response posture adopted before the first demand (ADR-166): what SIG holds and how it minimises it (SIG-SEC-002), who receives legal process (the operator as the disclosed interim legal home, ADR-165), preservation handling (append-only stores; a lawful request honoured as a recorded legal hold), the user-notice policy, and the publication of counts. The page states plainly that the text is **not legal advice and has not been reviewed by counsel** (ADR-167) and that **the warrant canary is declined, never operated**.
